spec.user_stories: - As a user, I open "/" in a browser and get the journal page (frontend/index.html). - As a browser, I load /static/style.css and /static/app.js from the frontend/ folder. - As an API client, I use POST /api/logs and GET /api/logs with exactly the behavior /logs had.
spec.acceptance_criteria: 1. GET / returns 200 with content-type text/html and a body equal to the contents of frontend/index.html. 2. GET /static/style.css and GET /static/app.js each return 200 (bodies empty, as the files are empty). 3. frontend/index.html references href="/static/style.css" and src="/static/app.js"; the rest of the file is byte-identical to before. 4. POST /api/logs and GET /api/logs behave identically to the former POST /logs and GET /logs (validation, status codes, upload rules, newest-first ordering). 5. POST /logs and GET /logs no longer exist: each returns 404 (not 405, not 200). 6. Requests to / and /static/* work when the server is started from backend/ and when tests run from any working directory (frontend path is not cwd-relative). 7. All 50 existing tests remain, retargeted to /api/logs, and pass; new tests cover criteria 1, 2 and 5. 8. After the test run, no DB file, uploads files, __pycache__ or .pytest_cache remain in the project; style.css and app.js are still empty; no new files are added to the project.
spec.assumptions: - BodyLimitMiddleware continues to apply app-wide; its behavior on the new paths is unchanged. - create_app signature is unchanged; the frontend directory is derived from the location of backend/main.py (sibling frontend/ folder). - Any existing assertions on the "/logs" string (e.g. Location headers or error messages) are updated to "/api/logs" only if they reference the path. - "Only /static/ serves frontend/" means /static/index.html may also resolve; this is acceptable.
spec.edge_cases: - Static mount must not shadow /api/logs or /. - GET /static/missing.txt returns 404. - Trailing-slash variants of /api/logs keep whatever behavior /logs had. - Test cleanup must hold even though tests now touch the real frontend/ folder (read-only).

risks.risk: Mounting static at "/" instead of "/static" would shadow routes; spec requires /static.
Cleanup of pycache/.pytest_cache is an operational step outside code and could be missed.

spec.dependencies: FastAPI/Starlette static file support (may need aiofiles-free StaticFiles, already part of Starlette); existing backend files and frontend/index.html.
spec.self_critique: Every story maps to criteria (1-3 frontend, 4-5 API, 6-8 robustness). All criteria are observable. Biggest risk: hidden coupling of existing tests to the "/logs" literal beyond request URLs, or a test client run that creates stray files.
